performance_case.causal_mechanism: One checksum-bound archive adapter and external-feature DRA runner converts a verified free public derivatives data path into three distinct joint-state experiment paths while preserving decision-time availability and the unchanged equal-capital parent.
performance_case.claim_boundary: A READY result proves only that synthetic and allowlisted pre-2025 samples can be checksum-validated, normalized without lookahead and consumed by one declarative research runner that exposes three closed joint feature identities and unchanged economic outputs. It proves no prediction, PnL, drawdown improvement, strategy, candidate, OOS, deployment or Trading authority.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero because no strategy or historical economics are executed. Future experiments must separately prove that each admission rule improves or preserves matched-capital drawdown and inventory paths.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: This consumes the single seven-day non-counting candidate-enabling capability allowance. It is justified only if one bounded six-file implementation leaves all three listed direct families one frozen hypothesis and manifest away from economic closure.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: Immediate strategy performance is unchanged. The capability should reduce source-to-decision latency by allowing the next three bounded research cycles to freeze and economically close one independent family each without another adapter implementation.
